title: Mongo-sharded: full cluster status (config RS + 2 shards + 2 mongos)
description: Runs `nexus status mongo-sharded` across all 11 nodes. One table rolls up the config-server RS, both shard RSes (ShardId column), and the 2 stateless mongos routers.

observe.what: 11-row table: config 1 primary + 2 secondary; shard-1 + shard-2 each 1 primary + 2 secondary (ShardId set); 2 routers alive
JSON ClusterStatusOutputJson: 11 members, overallHealth=green, shardId populated per RS member, router members shardId=null

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.GetStatusAsync queries each RS via __system (direct mongod) + each mongos via nexus-sharded-admin, classifying nodes by name prefix into config/shard-1/shard-2/router.
